title: WTT Champions Montpellier: Félix Lebrun and Chen Yi through as Matsushima survives Qiu
standfirst: The home favourite and China's Chen Yi won their opening matches on the first evening in Montpellier, while top seed Sora Matsushima needed an 11-2 deciding game to get past Germany's Dang Qiu.
body: Félix Lebrun began his WTT Champions Montpellier campaign with an 11-8, 11-3, 11-3 win over Denmark's Anders Lind in the round of 32 on Tuesday evening. Lind made the first game awkward, but once Lebrun had taken it he won 14 of the next 17 points, according to tennis2table.

Lebrun, who won his first WTT Champions title in Montpellier in 2024, said afterwards that a 3-0 win would give him confidence and that he has incredible memories of the venue. He plays Oh Junsung or Zhou Qihao in the round of 16.
Chen Yi lost the first game 12-10 to Chinese Taipei's Peng Yu-han after leading 9-8, then won the next three 11-4, 11-3, 11-5, Sina Sports reported. She meets Wang Manyu or Hana Goda next.

Matsushima, the top seed, led Qiu by two games to love and then lost the third 11-3 and the fourth 12-10. He controlled the decider from the start and took it 11-2, tischtennis.de reported. He plays Darko Jorgic or Vladimir Sidorenko in the round of 16.

Germany had a second defeat in the women's draw, where Romania's Elizabeta Samara beat Han Ying 11-8, 11-4, 8-11, 11-7. Han said her form had felt fine but something had been missing on the day. Samara joins her compatriot Bernadette Szőcs in the last 16.

Truls Moregard beat France's Thibault Poret 11-8, 11-6, 11-8 but reached for his shoulder during the third game and briefly paused before serving, Swedish outlets reported. He finished the match without further trouble, and it is not yet clear how serious the problem is. He meets Shunsuke Togami or Tomislav Pucar next.

In the afternoon session, Lin Yun-Ju came from 2-1 down to beat Portugal's João Geraldo 8-11, 11-4, 5-11, 11-4, 11-6, according to United Daily News. He won the fourth game after a timeout and a run of six points.
